title: Countdown Machine
brief: Time to make the computer do the boring, repetitive work! Your Countdown Machine asks for a starting number, then uses a loop to count all the way down to 1 and shout "Blast off!". A while loop repeats as long as its condition is True, so it's perfect for counting down. Fill in the two print lines, then press Check Project to launch!
steps: The first line is done for you: int(input(...)) asks for a starting number.
The while loop is set up to keep going while count is above 0 (it subtracts 1 each time so it always stops).
Inside the loop, add print(count) to show each number as it counts down.
After the loop, add print("Blast off!").
Run it and try a few numbers, then press Check Project.
starterCode:
# 🚀 Countdown Machine, it counts down and then blasts off!

start = int(input("Count down from what number? "))

# We count down using a while loop. It keeps going while count is above 0.
count = start
while count > 0:
    # 1) Print the current number:
    # print(count)
    count = count - 1   # step down by 1 (this is what stops the loop!)

# 2) After the loop finishes, print the blast off message:
# print("Blast off!")
inputHint: Type one number: the number to start counting down from.
successMessage: Blast off! 🚀 Your Countdown Machine loops all the way down and launches, that's the power of loops: you write the steps once and let Python do the repeating!
